item.title: Johnson: Trump's $5,000 checks need congressional approval

item.title: Why Trump's united Ireland stance sparked strong reactions
item.description: President Trump reaffirmed his support for a united Ireland on Sunday after his comments during a two-day visit drew backlash from unionist and British figures.
